mg.FaultHuntGame.note_bad_cable_symptom: Crackles or cuts out when you touch it.
mg.FaultHuntGame.note_bad_cable_fix: Swap the cable first. It is the cheapest thing to try.
mg.FaultHuntGame.note_noisy_psu_symptom: A steady buzz that never changes, whatever you play.
mg.FaultHuntGame.note_noisy_psu_fix: Move the power supply away from the audio cables.
mg.FaultHuntGame.note_dead_preamp_sympto: One channel is silent while the others move.
mg.FaultHuntGame.note_dead_preamp_fix: Plug the mic into a spare preamp to see if it is the channel.
mg.FaultHuntGame.note_ground_loop_sympto: A low hum that starts when two plugged-in devices are connected.
mg.FaultHuntGame.note_ground_loop_fix: Run everything off the same power strip.
mg.FaultHuntGame.note_phase_flip_symptom: Two mics together sound thin and hollow.
mg.FaultHuntGame.note_phase_flip_fix: Flip the polarity switch on one of them and the body comes back.
mg.debrief.gain.clipped: Take {{n}} peaked {{db}} dB hot at the {{stage}}, so everything after it clipped. Pull that stage back before the next one adds more.
mg.debrief.gain.noisy: Take {{n}} left the preamp at {{db}} dBFS, {{gap}} dB under where it should sit, so the fader had to lift the noise floor with it.
mg.debrief.phase.thin: Kit {{n}} went out with {{mics}} still out of polarity, so the mono sum only reached {{pct}}% and the low end thinned out.
mg.debrief.phase.flips: Kit {{n}} took {{flips}} flips where {{min}} would do. A listen shows which mic disagrees with the first channel before you touch a switch.
mg.debrief.chain.lost_first: The chain broke at the very first stage. The signal starts at the {{expected}}.
mg.debrief.chain.lost: The chain broke at stage {{stage}}. After the {{prev}} the signal goes to the {{expected}}, not somewhere else on the rack.
mg.debrief.chain.slips: Got there, but with {{n}} wrong tap(s) along the way. Say the path out loud as it lights.
mg.debrief.chain.replays: You leaned on the replay {{n}} time(s). Hum each pad pitch to lock the order in.
mg.debrief.gain.low: Take {{n}} printed {{db}} dB too quiet. Clean, but the mix will have to make it up later.
mg.debrief.gain.high: Take {{n}} printed {{db}} dB too hot for the print window. Nothing clipped, but there is no headroom left.
mg.debrief.eq.too_much: The {{region}} ended {{db}} dB too much. The reference sits at {{target}} dB there.
mg.debrief.eq.too_little: The {{region}} ended {{db}} dB short. The reference sits at {{target}} dB there.
